title: Task-Dependent Weighted Average Energy Controllability Score for Network Intervention
summary: Controllability scores provide principled information on where intervention should be applied in large-scale network systems when explicit control design is difficult. Two representative controllability scores are the volumetric controllability score (VCS) and the average energy controllability score (AECS). While both are important, the standard AECS treats all state-transition directions uniformly.
